DeprecationNotice.description: A structured deprecation declaration attached to a public surface.
DeprecationNotice.title: Deprecation Notice

ServiceConfigInput.description: Accepted Landofile service authoring surface with canonical keys and the working_dir, env_file, and depends_on Compose aliases.

allowOverride.description: Whether an Apache-backed service enables .htaccess overrides for its webroot.

depends_on.description: Compose alias for the canonical dependsOn service field; accepts a service-name list or condition map.

publication.description: Explicit host-publication intent and policy overrides.

env_file.description: Compose alias for the canonical envFile service field; accepts one path or a path list.

path.description: Single absolute in-container file path declared under `services.<name>.logs`.

webroot.description: Container path served as this service's HTTP document root.

working_dir.description: Compose alias for the canonical workingDirectory service field.

ServiceConfigInput.title: Service Config Input

ServiceDependency.description: A single inter-service dependency with its optional Compose condition, required, and restart flags.
ServiceDependency.title: Service Dependency

ServiceDependencyCondition.description: How a service dependency must be satisfied before dependents start: on process start, on healthcheck success, or on successful completion.
ServiceDependencyCondition.title: Service Dependency Condition

allow.description: Additional exact env-var names forwarded beyond the built-in agent-context allowlist (global agentEnv.allow).

deny.description: Built-in or allowed env-var names to suppress from forwarding (global agentEnv.deny).

enabled.description: Master switch for host agent-context env forwarding; default true (global agentEnv.enabled).

deliveryQueueCapacity.description: Positive per-subscriber event delivery queue capacity up to 65536 (global events.deliveryQueueCapacity; default 64).
deliveryQueueCapacity.title: lessThanOrEqualTo(65536)

allow.description: Canonical command ids allowed as MCP tools beyond the generated defaults (global mcp.allow).

deny.description: Canonical command ids denied as MCP tools; deny wins over allow (global mcp.deny).

maxConcurrent.description: Positive cap on concurrent MCP tool calls (global mcp.maxConcurrent; default 4).
maxConcurrent.title: positive

tooling.description: Project resolved app tooling tasks as MCP tools by default (global mcp.tooling).

commands.description: Additional canonical command ids beyond the default notify family (global notify.commands; max 128).
commands.title: maxItems(128)

enabled.description: Master switch for desktop notifications (global notify.enabled; default true).

thresholdMs.description: Minimum qualifying command duration in ms (global notify.thresholdMs; default 15000; 0 qualifies every eligible command).
thresholdMs.title: lessThanOrEqualTo(3600000)

lando.description: Semver range the running Lando core version must satisfy before the app is planned or started (e.g. ">=4.1 <5"). Prereleases are included; unsatisfied constraints fail closed with remediation.

arguments.description: Set to false to reject caller-supplied positional arguments for this task.
